verdict.rationale: Brex documents receipt match and receipt upload capabilities in its Expenses API, and its product page markets "automated receipts". Together these indicate receipts can be uploaded and matched to card expenses. However, the evidence never describes an email-forwarding receipt path or how matching to the right transaction works in the finance-lead experience. Missing for 10: documented email-in receipt capture, detail on automatic matching logic and accuracy in the product UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have receipts automatically attached to the right transaction by emailing or uploading them

citations.quote: Expenses API: View and manage card expenses data, receipt match and receipt uploads
Make expenses a breeze for employees and managers with automated receipts
